channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O que está em jogo em audiência de investigação dos EUA contra o Brasil em que Flávio Bolsonaro vai falar
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a senator and pre-candidate for president, will participate in the final day of U.S. public hearings on alleged unfair trade practices by Brazil, advocating against 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, especially to protect the Pix payment system. He claims the tariffs would constitute a 'political victory' for Lula’s government and urges a delay until after Brazil’s October elections. The investigation, launched in July 2023, includes private sector representatives from both nations, with a final decision expected by July 15.

item.title: A desconfortável escolha entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The text reflects extreme polarization in opinions about Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro among the author's acquaintances, illustrating visceral rejection on both sides: some would give Lula the middle finger, while others would send Flávio Bolsonaro to the U.S. on a one-way ticket. The choice between them is described as uncomfortable due to the depth of mutual aversion.

item.title: Nunes Marques irrita TSE e STF com nomeação da mulher do advogado de Castro
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques appointed the wife of Claudio Castro's lawyer to the vice-directorship of the Electoral Judicial School, surprising and disturbing ministers of the STF and TSE. The move was seen as a potential conflict of interest due to ties with the Rio de Janeiro governor. The appointment caused consternation over perceived lack of impartiality.

item.title: Mucio se reúne com oficial americano para abrir canal de diálogo após tipificação de PCC e CV
item.description: Defense Minister José Mucio will meet with U.S. Under Secretary of Defense for Policy Elbridge Colby to establish dialogue over the unilateral designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations by the Trump administration. The meeting in Cusco aims to reverse the decision and assess potential U.S. military intervention plans in Brazil, with Mucio coordinating with President Lula to uphold national sovereignty.

item.title: Alcolumbre dá sinais de bandeira branca a Lula no Senado
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) signaled rapprochement with the Lula government by meeting with the new government leader in the Senate, Teresa Leitão (PT-PE), praising her articulation skills and expressing willingness to understand government demands. Despite this, he upheld the constitutional process for the health agents' pension PEC, delaying its vote, and rejected the 'pauta-bomba' label, arguing Congress has approved measures benefiting the government. Government allies believe the leadership change has improved dialogue.

item.title: Planalto vê politização do tarifaço ganhar força com Flávio em audiência
item.description: The Lula government views Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's participation in a USTR public hearing on proposed U.S. tariffs as evidence that the measure is politically motivated, not technically justified. According to Planalto sources, Bolsonaro aims to use his appearance to craft an internal narrative that he acted to prevent the tariff, despite the absence of Brazilian government representatives. The administration attributes the tariff threat to the political actions of the Bolsonaro family, dismissing the technical basis of the USTR's findings.

item.title: Tarifaço: Flávio vai a audiência nos EUA em busca de “virar a página”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is attending a U.S. government public hearing on a proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, arguing the measure could benefit the Lula administration and harm internal opposition. He advocates for a negotiated resolution and opposes the action, claiming the tariffs are disproportionate and counterproductive. The hearing, part of the USTR’s Section 301 process, takes place on July 6–7 with at least 81 scheduled speakers.

item.title: Empresa ligada a PCC recebeu milhões de financiadora de Dark Horse
item.description: Entre Investimentos, which financed the Dark Horse film about Jair Bolsonaro, transferred R$26.2 million to ACX ITC, a company under investigation by São Paulo's Civil Police for alleged money laundering for the PCC. ACX ITC, registered in the name of a kite seller who admitted being a front, moved R$918 million according to Coaf and also sent funds to firms linked to STM and STJ ministers. The investigation, part of Operation Saturno, was forwarded to the Federal Police.

item.title: “Irmãs em Cristo”: Damares agradece Marina Silva por apoio
item.description: Senator Damares Alves thanked federal deputy Marina Silva for her public support after Damares and her adopted indigenous daughter faced online threats and insults. Damares emphasized that, despite their current opposing political positions, they share a past of joint struggle and a common Christian faith. Marina had condemned the misogyny directed at Damares, stating that no attack on women is justifiable, regardless of its source.

item.title: TSE convida União Africana e Liga Árabe para acompanhar eleições no Brasil
item.description: The TSE has invited the African Union and the Arab League to observe Brazil's 2026 elections, expanding international cooperation following the EU's invitation. In 2022, Brazil hosted eight electoral observation missions with 500 observers, highlighting confidence in the biometric system, speed, and transparency of its electoral process. For 2026, 158 million voters are expected to be eligible across 5,569 municipalities plus the DF, with 89% already having completed biometric data collection.

item.title: PT aceita decisão de Marília e fica mais longe de palanque forte em MG
item.description: The Minas Gerais PT has accepted that Marília Campos will not abandon her Senate candidacy, ending hopes she would run for governor. This weakens their ability to build a competitive Lula-aligned ticket in the state, prompting the party to consider alternatives like Sandra Goulart and negotiate with national leadership to name a candidate by July 20.

item.title: Do início promissor ao fim melancólico: Neymar encerra ciclo na Seleção
item.description: Neymar ended his Brazil national team career after the team's round-of-16 loss to Norway at the 2026 World Cup, scoring a penalty kick but delivering a subpar performance. His 16-year cycle, which began with promise in 2010, was marred by 13 injuries and limited playing time, concluding with him as a substitute and only two major titles with the national team.

item.title: Ministras cantam jingles pró-Lula em ato do PT com funcionários públicos
item.description: Ministers Rachel Barros and Margareth Menezes attended a PT event with public servants in Brasília, singing jingles in support of Lula's 2026 re-election bid. The 'Esplanada com Lula' gathering aimed to mobilize the party's base ahead of the official campaign and featured criticism of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential pre-candidate.

item.title: “Não podemos temer bolsonarismo e temos de radicalizar”, diz Guimarães
item.description: Minister José Guimarães (PT-CE) stated that PT militants must not fear bolsonarism and should radicalize Lula’s 2026 re-election campaign, especially in the streets, even during the electoral blackout period. He also endorsed Leandro Grass’s pre-candidacy for the DF governorship, urging him to 'radicalize against bolsonarists' and 'deliver a big blow' in the race.

item.title: Flávio recalibra discurso e leva embate com Lula à audiência nos EUA com defesa do Pix e do fim do tarifaço
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro recalibrated his discourse at the USTR hearing in Washington, advocating for the suspension of the 25% tariff proposed by the U.S. and reinforcing his opposition to the measure, while escalating his clash with Lula by accusing the government of politicizing the trade crisis and defending Pix as a symbol of economic sovereignty.

item.title: Na retranca fiscal: governo faz ofensiva para tentar barrar derrubada de vetos que podem aumentar gastos públicos
item.description: The Lula government is intensifying negotiations with Congress to avoid voting on presidential vetoes with significant fiscal impact in the upcoming joint session, particularly those related to the offshore wind energy law, which include coal subsidies and mandatory gas thermal plant contracts. The strategy repeats the June articulation, limiting the agenda to consensus topics to prevent increases in mandatory spending or reductions in revenue that would undermine the fiscal responsibility narrative.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro participa nesta terça de audiência nos EUA sobre tarifas de Trump a produtos brasileiros
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attends a USTR public hearing in Washington to oppose the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian goods and defend the PIX payment system, arguing it does not replace credit cards and should not be linked to non-Western systems. He also urges a 180-day delay on tariffs, claiming they harm U.S. investments in Brazil and politically strengthen President Lula in an election year.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro participa hoje de audiência pública nos EUA sobre tarifaço: entenda como será a reunião
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is participating today in the USTR public hearing in the U.S., aiming to distance himself from the negative electoral impact of the proposed 25% tariff on Brazilian products by the Trump administration. He argues the measure would politically benefit President Lula and has requested the suspension of the tariff in a submission to the agency. While the Lula government pursues diplomatic channels, the senator is using the event to bolster his image as a PL presidential pre-candidate.

item.title: Edinho associa clã Bolsonaro a “entreguismo” e pede embate nas redes
item.description: Edinho Silva, national president of the Workers' Party (PT), criticized Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro for allegedly offering Brazil to the United States in trade and investment negotiations, accusing the Bolsonaro family of 'surrenderism' and inspiring a fascist movement. He called on PT militants to wage an unrelenting battle on social media to counter the perception that these platforms belong to the right and to rebalance political forces ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Após Datafolha, equipe de Haddad avalia antecipar anúncio de pacote da segurança
item.description: Fernando Haddad's (PT) team is considering accelerating the announcement of his public security proposals after a Datafolha poll showed his likely opponent, Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos), leading with 52% of valid votes — close to the threshold for winning outright in the first round of the 2026 São Paulo gubernatorial election.

item.title: Mendonça vira peça-chave no embate entre Flávio e Michelle com relatoria do caso 'Dark Horse'
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça has been appointed as rapporteur for the 'Dark Horse' case investigations, positioning him as a key figure in the conflict between Michelle Bolsonaro, his personal friend, and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, with whom he has no close relationship. The decision underscores his strategic role in the political dispute involving the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Flávio diz que Lula usa soberania como “falsa narrativa” sobre tarifas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for president, accused President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) of using the defense of national sovereignty as a 'false narrative' regarding U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products. He stated he traveled to the United States to present a 'technical defense' of Brazil's interests and expressed confidence that the tariffs would not take effect, criticizing the Lula government's handling of trade negotiations.

item.title: Por que o bolsonarismo tem dificuldade para atrair o voto de mulheres
item.description: The gender gap in Brazilian voting behavior has widened since 2018, reaching a new level in 2026 projections, with women increasingly favoring the left and men the right, according to political scientist Fábio Vasconcellos. This trend, mirrored in the U.S., poses specific challenges for right-wing campaigns, which increasingly rely on female leaders like Michelle Bolsonaro to appeal to women voters, despite her deteriorating relationship with Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Exército diz ao STF que entregou 6 das 8 armas de Bolsonaro à PF
item.description: The Brazilian Army informed the STF that it had delivered 6 of the 8 firearms registered in the name of Jair Bolsonaro to the Federal Police, as ordered by Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Two weapons — a Glock pistol seized by the DF Military Police with a Bolsonaro aide and a Typhoon 12-gauge shotgun — are not in the Army’s custody: the former was previously seized, and the latter was never taken possession of by Bolsonaro, remaining under the custody of an arms importer in Caxias do Sul. Bolsonaro’s defense suggests the STF should formally request the company to confirm possession and deliver the shotgun to authorities.

item.title: PGR pede ao STF nova tentativa de notificar ex-ministro Silvio Almeida
item.description: Attorney General Paulo Gonet has asked the STF to make a new attempt to notify former minister Silvio Almeida so he can present a defense in the sexual harassment complaint filed by former minister Anielle Franco. Without notification, the case remains stalled, preventing the STF's Second Chamber from deciding whether to accept the indictment. Almeida was dismissed in September 2024 following allegations of sexual and moral harassment.

item.title: A estratégia de Flávio Bolsonaro que pode se mostrar equivocada
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro linked Brazil's World Cup elimination to the Lula government, claiming that since 2002 the country 'hasn't won anything' and promising to 'win Brazil'. However, VEJA's politics editor José Benedito argued this strategy is unlikely to resonate electorally, as Brazilians blame the team's on-field performance, not the federal government, for the loss.

item.title: Brasileiros "adotam" Haaland após Noruega eliminar a Seleção da Copa
item.description: Norway defeated Brazil 2-1 in the World Cup, with Erling Haaland scoring both goals, sparking a wave of memes and supportive messages from Brazilian fans on social media who 'adopted' the Norwegian striker. Despite the loss, many Brazilians praised Haaland's respectful conduct and expressed support for Norway in their upcoming quarterfinal match against England.

item.title: O agravante na negociação do tarifaço dos Estados Unidos ao Brasil
item.description: The main obstacle in reversing U.S. tariffs on Brazilian products is the lack of direct political communication between Presidents Lula and Trump. According to VEJA's political editor José Benedito, Trump's tariff policy is driven more by domestic political gains than economic strategy, making a reversal unlikely despite technical negotiations. The final decision rests solely with Trump, and political channels remain blocked at a critical time.

item.title: Zema diz que Renan Santos 'não teve experiência' e 'sai dando tiro como metralhadora'
item.description: Romeu Zema (Novo) criticized Renan Santos (Missão), stating he 'had no experience in public management' and 'shoots like a machine gun, promising worlds and funds'. Zema noted that polls highlighting Renan are online-based and not representative of the Brazilian population, and that Renan, 42 and founder of the MBL, advocates for the death penalty and restricting the STF. Zema, former Minas Gerais governor aged 61, positions himself as a 'third way' alternative between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha avalia pedir arquivamento de inquérito à PF
item.description: The defense of Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) is considering requesting a meeting with the Federal Police director-general to seek the dismissal of the investigation due to lack of evidence, arguing that even after breaking secrecy, no direct link was found between Lulinha and businessman Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes (Careca do INSS). Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça, the case's rapporteur, authorized the breach of secrecy and ordered internet providers to preserve data, while the PF cites staffing shortages as the reason for needing more time to conclude the probe.

item.title: Após ordem de Moraes, Exército entrega 6 armas de Bolsonaro à PF
item.description: The Brazilian Army handed over six firearms registered in the name of former President Jair Bolsonaro to the Federal Police, following an order by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Two weapons — a 9mm Glock pistol and a Maestro Arms Company 12-gauge shotgun — were not found at the Army Police Battalion. The delivery was completed within the 48-hour deadline set by Moraes.

item.title: Prazo para entrega de códigos-fonte da fiscalização eleitoral termina nesta segunda
item.description: The deadline for electoral oversight entities to submit source codes and public keys to the TSE ends this Monday, April 6, as part of preparations for the 2026 General Elections. These materials are crucial for verifying the integrity and authenticity of electoral systems, including digital signing and sealing. The deadline also applies for the TSE to review MRE requests regarding overseas voting sections, aiming to ensure voting access for Brazilians abroad.

item.title: Zema critica Renan Santos e admite ‘rejulgamento’ de Bolsonaro em vez de anistia
item.description: Romeu Zema criticized Renan Santos for lacking public management experience and making generic promises, ruled out an alliance with Ronaldo Caiado due to Gilberto Kassab being named as vice, and admitted that amnesty for Bolsonaro might be replaced by a 'rejudgment' with more impartial judges. He advocated for public spending cuts 'well above' Temer's spending cap, arguing that lowering interest rates from 14.5% to 6.5% would save R$700 billion annually in debt service.

item.title: PL lançará Flávio Bolsonaro à Presidência em 25 de julho
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has set July 25 for its national convention in São Paulo’s Mercado Pago Hall to formalize Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy for 2026. The event will also nominate candidates for state and federal offices, aiming to showcase party unity after internal conflicts and leaked conversations involving the senator. Holding the convention in São Paulo is strategic due to its large electorate and proximity to Governor Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Exército nega estar com duas de oito armas de Bolsonaro; restante do arsenal foi entregue à PF
item.description: The Army's Police Battalion in Brasília told the STF that two of the eight firearms allegedly possessed by former President Jair Bolsonaro are no longer in their custody, one matching the weapon seized in a traffic stop involving a military aide to Bolsonaro. The remaining six weapons were handed over to the Federal Police. Minister Alexandre de Moraes had ordered the surrender of all 10 weapons linked to Bolsonaro, with eight reportedly held by the Battalion and two already in Federal Police custody since April 2023.

item.title: Empresária pede arquivamento de investigação no STF e diz que só é alvo por ser "amiga íntima" de Lulinha
item.description: Businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger asked Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça to dismiss the investigation against her, claiming she is being targeted solely due to her 'close friendship' with Lulinha, President Lula’s son. Her defense argues there is no financial evidence linking her to Lulinha and that payments received were for legitimate consulting work in Brazil’s cannabidiol regulation sector, supported by contracts and invoices.

item.title: Princesa da Noruega cumprimenta Haaland após vitória sobre o Brasil
item.description: Norwegian Princess Ingrid Alexandra greeted the Norway team after their victory over Brazil in the 2026 World Cup round of 16, including star striker Erling Haaland, who scored two goals. Haaland leads the tournament scoring chart with seven goals, tied with Mbappé and Messi. Norway will face England in the quarterfinals on July 11 in Miami.

item.title: Eliminação para a Noruega abre debate sobre o futuro da seleção brasileira
item.description: The Brazilian national team was eliminated from the 2026 World Cup after losing to Norway, sparking internal criticism of the CBF and igniting debate over the future of the squad. The loss ends Brazil's participation in the tournament and intensifies pressure for reforms in management and team performance.

item.title: Governo Lula libera R$ 33,89 bilhões de emendas em 2026 e bate recorde
item.description: The Lula government disbursed R$ 33.89 billion in parliamentary amendments between January and the first week of July 2026, the highest amount ever recorded for this period in an election year. This figure exceeds the totals from the last five electoral cycles and corresponds to 75.3% of the total paid in 2025 (R$ 44.97 billion). Individual amendments were the largest category (R$ 18.55 billion), followed by committee amendments (R$ 7.68 billion) and state bloc amendments (R$ 7.28 billion).

item.title: Eleições Gerais de 2026: termina nesta segunda (6) prazo para entrega de códigos-fonte ao TSE
item.description: The deadline for submitting verification program source codes and corresponding public keys to the TSE ends this Monday (July 6), with 90 days remaining until the first round of the 2026 general elections. Oversight entities must comply with STI/TSE technical specifications under Resolution TSE No. 23.673/2021, or risk being required to provide development tool licenses. The submitted material will remain under Electoral Justice custody until the election.

item.title: CNMP realiza 1ª visita ao TSE para inspecionar códigos-fonte dos sistemas das Eleições 2026
item.description: The National Council of the Public Ministry (CNMP) conducted its first technical visit to the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) to inspect the source code of the electoral systems to be used in the 2026 General Elections. The activity is part of the Democratic Transparency Cycle, aiming to ensure auditability, transparency, and trust in the electoral process. During the visit, the TSE technical team demonstrated the functioning of the electronic ballot box and systems responsible for vote preparation, transmission, tallying, and results disclosure.

item.title: TSE fará simulados com veículos de imprensa para testar divulgação dos resultados das Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE held a technical meeting with media outlets and technology companies to detail infrastructure, security, and results distribution rules for the 2026 General Elections. The goal is to ensure the official vote count data is disseminated stably and securely, without alterations or improper charges by companies. The TSE plans to conduct simulation tests of the results flow from 0% to 100% to assess system resilience.

item.title: Líder do PL no Ceará critica demora de Priscila Costa em disputa entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: Silvana Oliveira, leader of the PL in Ceará, criticized councilwoman Priscila Costa for delaying her stance in the dispute between Michelle Bolsonaro and Flávio Bolsonaro over the party's candidacy, claiming it caused a 'great harm' to the party. The PL leadership in the state views Priscila's hesitation as damaging to party unity ahead of defining the candidate for the 2026 election.

item.title: STF nega pedido da Assembleia do Paraná para cassação de Renato Freitas
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin denied a petition by the Legislative Assembly of Paraná to overturn a suspension of the cassation process against state deputy Renato Freitas (PT-PR), keeping the cassation vote on hold. The ruling upholds a favorable injunction from the Paraná Court of Justice, preventing the assembly from proceeding with the mandate revocation. The incident dates back to November 2025, when Freitas was involved in a confrontation with a parking attendant in Curitiba, claiming he acted in self-defense against an alleged attempt to run over him and his pregnant wife.

item.title: PL marca convenção nacional para lançar Flávio Bolsonaro à Presidência
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) will hold its national convention on July 25 at Mercado Pago Hall in São Paulo to launch Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential candidacy for 2026. The event will take place eight days before the PT’s convention to formalize Lula’s re-election bid, within the electoral period set by the Superior Electoral Court (July 20 to August 5). Flávio’s candidacy has faced recent setbacks due to leaked audio in which he asks for money from businessman Daniel Vorcaro and allegations of mistreatment by Michelle Bolsonaro.

item.title: Justiça limita escolta de Caiado a 4 PMs
item.description: The Goiás judiciary ruled that presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) must reduce his personal security detail from 51 to only 4 military police officers, a provisional decision issued by Judge Vinícius Caldas da Gama. The measure affects Caiado’s and his family’s security, sparking debate over the protection of public officials during electoral campaigns.

item.title: A resposta do Brasil aos EUA sobre investigação que pode terminar com novo tarifaço
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira rejected the USTR's recommendation to impose an additional 12.5% tariff on Brazilian imports, arguing that Brazil has one of the most comprehensive legal and institutional frameworks to combat forced labor. He stated that the USTR's conclusion is superficial, arbitrary, and incompatible with the multilateral trading system, advocating that trade disputes should be resolved through formal mechanisms like the WTO, not unilateral punitive measures.

item.title: PT faz ato de pré-campanha de Lula com funcionários públicos
item.description: The PT holds a pre-campaign event for Lula in Brasília with public employees, asserting the gathering is lawful, takes place outside working hours, is fully funded by party resources, and involves voluntary participation without use of public resources or explicit vote solicitation.

item.title: Justiça de Goiás reduz seguranças de Caiado de 51 para 4 policiais militares
item.description: Judge Vinícius Caldas da Gama e Abreu of Goiás' 2nd Public Finance Court issued a provisional injunction requiring presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado to reduce his security detail from 51 to four military police officers, including protection for family members. The ruling aims to balance personal security with the reasonable use of public resources.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro fala em “Neymarfobia” da “TV Globo”
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro accused TV Globo of practicing 'Neymarfobia' or a disguised 'Bolsonarophobia' for criticizing Neymar's performance after Brazil's elimination by Norway in the 2026 World Cup. He argued the network unfairly labels public figures like Neymar and Jair Bolsonaro despite their popular support, and emphasized that Neymar scored Brazil's only goal in the match.
